# react-native-tvos — account brief

## Who
react-native-tvos is a GitHub organization ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos)) with 23 public repos and 51 followers ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos)). The evidence does not say what the organization sells or whether it is a company.

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in react-native-tvos/IgniteTV ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV/blob/main/eas.json)).
- The IgniteTV repo was last pushed 2026-05-28 ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV)).
- No evidence of CI config, React Native version, or app store activity was collected.

## Who to talk to
- Douglas Lowder (@douglowder), top contributor to react-native-tvos/IgniteTV with 48 commits ([source](https://github.com/douglowder)). His GitHub profile lists company `@expo`, website https://douglowder.com, and the bio "Currently at @expo. Ported the React Native framework to the Apple TV platform." ([source](https://github.com/douglowder)).

## Why now
IgniteTV was last pushed 2026-05-28 ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV)). The evidence has no store update cadence and no React Native version, so recency beyond that push date is unknown.

## Suggested opener
Douglas, you have 48 commits in react-native-tvos/IgniteTV, the most of any contributor ([source](https://github.com/douglowder)). The repo carries an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV/blob/main/eas.json)) and was last pushed on 2026-05-28 ([source](https://github.com/react-native-tvos/IgniteTV)). What does the build and update path for IgniteTV look like on the TV targets today?

**Note on this one:** the only named contact's profile says he already works at Expo ([source](https://github.com/douglowder)), so this is likely an internal repo rather than a prospect. Worth checking before it goes in a send queue.
